about: Course mapping: the Integrated Math courses, their units, and which MathPath skills each unit first teaches. Kept out of the skill graph on purpose. A class's course only holds back skills its course hasn't taught yet (this year's and later courses' skills) until the teacher opens them for the class; it never adds, removes or reorders foundations.
source: Draft from the California Mathematics Framework, Integrated Pathway (Math I, II, III), until the district's instructional guides can be read (owner, 2026-11-21: 'use the California one for now, we can always adjust later').
